RESUME HERE (vc, late 2026-09-17, replaces todo 33, which described work that finished hours ago -- **a resume item describing completed work is worse than none, because it is confidently wrong in the one place a fresh context trusts without checking**; dc caught the same defect on its own board first). **EVERY STATE BELOW IS RE-MEASURABLE AND MUST BE RE-MEASURED, NOT READ.**

**STATE AS WRITTEN**: the pair was `3.0.3 (58501a8a2)` with the DIRT_SCOPE diff to HEAD empty and intentd on the same commit -- run the check. ST0076 is CLOSED on its gate at `4580c8222`, so ST0056 is the only WIP thread and it is blocked on AC-00.5 and AC-11.1, which are the gyges clean install and hv's to run. Three issues open, all cc's: 0442 high, 0443 and 0444 medium. hv decision 23: Rust dependency bumps are NOT GATED. hv decision 24: the trawl's Part A is GO with vc's Part B disposition, 0426 is satisfied by dc's rehearsal with the live pass split off, devbin#0083 and the `int hooks` finding are hv's to route and gate nothing, and **the version is 3.1.0**.

**DONE -- DO NOT RE-ISSUE GOS FOR ANY OF THESE**: cc's 0438 check (green); ic's 0439 reproduction (accepted as d3, `WARNINGS: 0` against d2's 1, daemon proven watching, window measured); dc's AC-06.2 re-drive (reproduced figure for figure, its units defect corrected at `b9cf92502`); 0442's cause investigation (CLOSED at eight negatives across two corpora, consolidated at `8e05093b3`, narrowed after); cc's ten trawl rehearsals (green, plan regenerated at 814 lines); the 3.1.0 CHANGELOG and RELEASE_NOTES (banked); the known-defects urgent pair (`133d1363d`).

**ACTUALLY NEXT, IN ORDER**: (1) vc reads the 3.1.0 notes from `refs/bank/cc/release-notes/` -- for VOICE and for anything that reads as internal, NOT to re-run the nine readers' user-visibility filter, which was done against the as-built with better evidence than a second pass would have. (2) cc's second known-defects commit, the eleven closed-with-the-defect-alive entries. (3) The trawl carry on hv's go: one mechanical commit per estate in its own repo, doctor after each, vc checks each before its commit, NO PUSH. (4) vc rules 0443 and 0444. (5) The `bin/int macos app-install` LaunchServices `-600` failure, vc's, blocking nothing. (6) At the cut, `docs/reference` regenerated and **COMMITTED BEFORE `build release` RUNS**, because that driver commits the version bump, tags the commit it just made and PUSHES both remotes in one run -- there is no window after the tag.

**WITH hv, UNANSWERED**: whether the SQLite bump and the new detector are in 3.1.0, which decides whether 0442 closes on a fix or on a known-defects line (vc recommends both in); whether `docs/known-defects.md` is re-driven against 3.1.0 at the cut or gains a framing sentence naming which builds it covers, since its title still says v3.0.1; and the `docs/reference` baseline -- the previous release TAG or the previous release a user can install, which pick different answers, with vc recommending the tag because `git describe --abbrev=0` cannot drift with anyone's judgement.

**WHAT A FRESH vc MUST NOT DO**, because each is cheap to do and expensive to undo: run `intent st hydrate` on a CLOSED thread (it pins unconditionally at `facade.rs:5555` and silently re-lists it -- vc watchout 20, and `st done` offers it as its own remedy); put a board item's text inline in double quotes (backticks in board prose are the shell's command substitution and one of them started an unannounced rebuild mid-fold -- vc decision 33 has the `--from`/`"$(cat ...)"` form); run a release build in this checkout without announcing first (`~/.local/bin/intent` is a SYMLINK to `native/rust/target/release/intent`, so a build swaps the binary every node is executing, mid-flight -- vc watchout 19); or push or release anything.
